reviewed_by: Claude review of MCP server descriptions
reason: McpServerProfile gains an operator-written description (up to 500 characters). Jev ranks an on-demand server by it, falling back to its handshake instructions and then its tool names as before. Once tools are picked for a turn, by Jev or by the local ranker, the catalog receipt records the servers behind the picks and Jev's ranked servers (ToolSuggestionReceipt.source_ids is new), and catalog_instructions tells the model which server each pick comes from and, as JSON data, what the operator says each of those servers is for. Handshake instructions still never reach the model. The mcp.json importer now maps `description` (previously skipped), truncating past 500 characters with a warning; a re-import without one keeps the Nebula-written value, and export writes it. Settings gets a Description field in the Add/Edit MCP server dialog and a two-line description on the server card, per the approved Figma mockup. test_tool_catalog.py covers the instruction text (server names on picks, the description line, old receipts without sources), picked_sources ordering, and the local-ranker path through ChatService.prepare. test_tool_suggestions.py covers the description beating handshake instructions in Jev's criteria, source_ids on the receipt, and the Jev path through prepare into the model's instructions. test_mcp_import.py covers import, truncation, keep-on-silent-reimport, replace-on-described-reimport, export round trip, type errors, the regenerated schema, and the REST create/patch/length limit. test_operator_help.py is selected because the MCP help entry changed; test_chat.py because chat.py changed. HarnessSettings.test.tsx covers editing, saving and showing the description; client.test.ts covers the wire mapping. The mcp-import real-Core journey drives the MCP settings section and edit dialog on desktop and at 390px.
exclusions: Full Python, frontend and Playwright suites are excluded. No native tests: no Rust changed. The mcp-import area is limited to its desktop and chromium-390 entries, both run locally and passing; the other widths render the same dialog and card markup. The assistant, provider-reasoning and tool-suggestions areas that chat.py and tool_suggestions.py map to are not selected: the chat.py change only attaches server details to the catalog receipt, which the selected Python tests assert through ChatService.prepare, and no chat UI changed. The core-api area that domain.py maps to is not selected: the new field is optional with a default, and the REST path is covered by test_mcp_import.py. ui/src/api/types.ts and components-domain.css are covered by the HarnessSettings and client tests plus the selected real-Core journey. Missions, schedules, subagents and harness chats do not read the catalog receipt, so their suites are not selected; test_chat_tool_loop, test_chat_goals, test_chat_schedules, test_chat_subagents, test_harnesses, test_exporter, test_mcp_probe and test_mcp_gateway were run locally and pass.
